annotations.text: Bike Detail, updated. New: a Purchase receipt row between components and rides that opens the image fullscreen. Ride rows are now tappable, with a note preview and a chevron, and open Ride Details. View all opens the full history.

Ride Details, new screen. Reached by tapping a ride. Date, distance and notes editable inline. Save changes re-applies the distance delta to currently-active components. Delete ride opens the confirm dialog.
All Rides, new screen. Flat newest-first list, no month grouping. Reached from View all on Bike Detail. Each row opens Ride Details.
Add / Edit Bike, updated. New Purchase receipt field below Serial number, mirroring the Photo control. Shown filled; empty state reads + Add receipt image like the photo box above it.
Delete confirm dialog. Styled to match the app modals rather than a browser confirm. Red Delete action, matches the overdue wear colour.
